QuestInfo.name: Anniversary : Cody's Quest
QuestInfo.0: Cody is supposedly in need of help. I should go see him at Henesys...
QuestInfo.1: Cody said he's preparing a big party for the MapleStory staff with food and everything, but he forgot to buy the birthday candles for the cake! He seemed to be in a state of emergency, and asked me if I could gather up #b10 Birthday Candles#k for him. #bBirthday Candles#k? That's weird...\n\n#t4031305# #b#c4031305#/10#k
QuestInfo.2: I gave him the #b10 Birthday Candles#k he requested. He seemed very much relieved by the fact that the party won't be ruined after all. He gave me a #rMaple Flag#k as a reward. Wow, I haven't seen these in a while!

0.0: Hey, what's going on? Can you believe it? MapleStory is nearing its very first birthday! It's all thanks to great Maplers like you! Well, anyway, we plan on having a big party among the MapleStory staff, and I need your help, big time. Can you help me out?

yes.0: Thanks! Well, we have the cake, the food, and everything else needed for a grand party, but I forgot to buy something very important: #bCANDLES#k! I mean, what's a birthday party without the candles on the cake, you know? We'll need #b10 Birthday Candles#k for the party, so please get them for me fast. I'll be here waiting for you. Good luck!

no.0: Oh, I see... that's alright. You must be busy with your other quests. But if you ever have a spare time, then please help me out here! I'll be here waiting for you...

1.0: Oh my goodness, you really did bring all #b10 of the Birthday Candles#k that I asked you to get! Nicely done!

yes.0: Thanks a whole bunch for your help! Phew, I could have gotten chewed out by my boss for this. Anyway, here's something for you. Hope you like it! Well, I'm off to tha par-tay, so I'll see you later! Happy Mapling!

item.0: I don't think you have the #b10 Birthday Candles#k that I asked you to get. The party is going to start soon, and I'll need those #bBirthday Candles#k fast! Please hurry!
